==Dialogue==
:'''Chijue:''' It breaks my heart every time I take in a Jade Steed Hauler with an empty container in its belly.

:'''Chijue:''' They're remarkably loyal machines, almost inseparable from their owners. I fear those merchants have already…

:'''Wenrong:''' But if you keep them locked up here, you're only protecting them from the weather. Why not send them to the Ministry of Development?

:'''Wenrong:''' These intricately crafted Steeds are built to last. If the master craftsmen there can refurbish them, they can be given a second life.

:'''Chijue:''' You're right. Since their owners are gone, we should ensure their legacy is put to good use.
{{Dialogue End}}
